text: 90+3分、Seabrook Townのキアン・ロマーノが、トマス・コワルスキからの短いパスを受け、ゴール前3.2メートルで強烈なシュートを決めました。これはほぼ決まる確率が9割5分のチャンスで、同点から4-2のリードに変わる大きなゴールです[#1906][#1904]。この攻撃は、相手のクリアボールから素早く反撃し、3回のパスで自陣から最後のエリアまでスムーズに運んだもので、Seabrook Townの3-4-3フォーメーションと広いサイドプレーの良さが生きていました[#1901][#1902]。この試合の後半10分間では、Seabrook Townが56%のボール支配を持ち、2ゴールを決めてHarbour Cityを圧倒しています。

- Kian Romano scored a goal with a foot shot from 3.2 meters during open play, assisted by Tomas Kowalski's short pass [#1906, #1904].
- The goal changed the score from 2-3 to 2-4, giving Seabrook Town the lead in the 90+3' minute [#moment].
- The build-up involved 3 passes over 13.2 seconds starting from own half at x=59.0, involving Elias Haddad, Callum Varga, Tomas Kowalski, and Kian Romano [#moment].
- In the last 10 minutes, Seabrook Town had 2 goals, 1.66 xG, 4 shots, and 56% possession whereas Harbour City had no shots or goals [#last_10_minutes].
- Seabrook Town played with a 3-4-3 formation focusing on wide, crossing play, coached by Mara Lindholm [#team_styles].

- The goal emerged from a well-executed counter-attack initiated by Harbour City's clearance [#1901], quickly transitioned by Seabrook Town through a long progressive pass from Elias Haddad to Callum Varga, highlighting Seabrook’s capability to exploit transition moments using their wide players [#1902, #1903].
- The build-up featured a rapid sequence of three passes over 13.2 seconds involving four players starting from their own half (x=59) and advancing decisively into the final third [#fact.build_up], demonstrating an effective use of Seabrook Town's 3-4-3 formation aimed at wide, crossing play; here, instead of a cross, a short assist from Tomas Kowalski to Kian Romano led to the finish [#1904].
- The attacking move reflected Seabrook’s style of exploiting wide spaces but also showed versatility by combining long passes and quick short interplay, culminating in a high-probability shot (xG 0.952) from close range by Romano [#1906].
- Harbour City’s 4-2-3-1 patient short passing style was disrupted late in the match, as they failed to retain possession under pressure, allowing Seabrook to capitalize on a high turnover and secure a decisive lead in the 90+3' minute [#last_10_minutes].
